user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search feature results.
user_agents.scope: Websites indexed for search answers in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawlable for generative AI foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested directly by users via ChatGPT or GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Content retrieved at user direction in response to user queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates web and analyzes content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image

user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, favicons
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Search features and dependent products
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the Google News app
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl for surfaces of Google Shopping
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot

user_agents.name: GoogleOther

user_agents.scope: Various product teams for internal research and development
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible image URLs
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible video URLs
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot

user_agents.name: Google-Extended

user_agents.scope: Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect data to gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Collect data to gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products including Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.scope: Webpages crawled for search indexing and to train foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines data usage for Apple generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls app or website content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image, and performs security checks.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt, though may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy, citing and linking content in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web to train foundation AI models and index content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs fetches requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search index and Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Bing search index and Microsoft Copilot generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use nochat meta tag.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates snapshots and previews of web pages.
user_agents.scope: Bing search result page previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: adidxbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls ads landing pages for quality checks.
user_agents.scope: Microsoft Advertising landing page verification.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Microsoft-inspection-tool
user_agents.purpose: Crawls pages for Bing Webmaster Tools URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Bing Webmaster Tools inspection requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawl web content to improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use page-level noarchive meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to make it eligible to appear in search experiences like Alexa.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or use page-level noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live information from the web to support user-initiated actions.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions such as responding to Alexa queries requiring up-to-date information.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are initiated by users.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building open datasets of web pages for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset of the web stored for open research and analysis.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: CCBot or register with the opt-out registry.
